title: Prove a shifted one-step threshold including sharp m=7 (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, produced by Nick Petalas. For positive integers d0,a,b, let D=d0*b. A sufficient threshold for `(m+1)^D < 2^a*m^D` is

```text
T = 1                             if a>D,
    max(2,ceil((3D-a)/(2a)))       otherwise.
```

It never exceeds the cited `ceil(27D/(17a))` threshold. It answers Open next question 1 of unpaidmoon #7450 with a bound that depends on m:

```diff
 (d0,a,b) = (1,1,5)
- sufficient threshold 8
+ sufficient threshold 7, proved sharp
```

The sharp four at `(1,2,5)` is preserved. The new step applies the classical decreasing function `(2x+1)*log(1+1/x)` to the auxiliary persistence comparison. No novelty is claimed for the analytic inequality itself. The self-contained proof is in `research/shifted-persistence-threshold/PROOF.md`.

Source question: unpaidmoon #7450 at `f9b9057f9befe744df7f6b58b61b53e77001af1f`; its census and persistence construction are cited, not audited or replayed. Credit its retained persistence-note lineage, Mister-Meeseeks's #7000 application review, and classical convexity and induction. Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; card `uniform-transfer-audit`, changed to this auxiliary threshold lemma. [Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19572802).

## Evidence

Before: the uniform power-pair method in #7450 leaves the specified m=7 step outside its sufficient region. After: the written proof includes it for every later integer, and the exact failure at m=6 proves sharpness.

Local CPython 3.12.15, standard library only. Normal and optimized commands pass, timed separately at 0.033 and 0.039 seconds. The registered workload checks 255 shifted-power inequalities, 255 consecutive decreases, all 9,216 parameter pairs a,D=1..96 and 27,648 one-step evaluations. In that rectangle, 4,753 threshold pairs strictly improve. Nine semantic controls and eight exact-reason invalid-input controls pass. Output marker `PASS_SHIFTED_PERSISTENCE_THRESHOLD` comes with generated SHA256 hashes for all six package files. Package metadata/pins and committed bytes/modes/source history pass at `844ea8372f3e1605bed1368f0a0135a177d6aa2f`.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/shifted-persistence-threshold/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -W error -B research/shifted-persistence-threshold/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/shifted-persistence-threshold
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/shifted-persistence-threshold --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Other hosts may substitute their CPython 3.12 path. Registered commands use `{python}`. No predecessor scientific verifier was run.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is a sufficient threshold, not the general exact minimum. At D=10,a=1 it gives fifteen while fourteen already works. It proves persistence once an initial comparison holds; it does not construct the initial successful index or a complete selected cutoff. No physical supplier, new kappa, assumption discharge or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

The selected cold replay, predecessor suites, physical/compiler/native/ownership/precision/tape/recovery proofs, Lean and Docker were not run. Ruff and Mypy are unavailable on the local PATH; in-memory compilation and warning-strict normal/optimized replay pass. The isolated verifier documents its bounded managed-runtime allocation deviation.

## Open next questions

Can another explicit rational term in the logarithm bound reduce the remaining sufficient-versus-necessary gap, starting with D=10,a=1? First derive the corrected integer test and prove it is never worse. Complete cutoffs and physical costs remain separate obligations. No follow-up is reserved.

## Related open work

- #7450, unpaidmoon: supplies the prior 27/17 threshold and asks about m=7. This proof includes that case and retains the same sharp four; no predecessor census is replayed.
- #7286, unpaidmoon: improves a monomial elimination record count elsewhere in the same application review. Its object and count are independent of this one-step inequality.

The completion refresh inspected this account's five other open PRs created since the CLAIM, #7470 through #7474. They study different objects and do not compute a competing threshold for this one-step comparison. No extra mathematical computation was run to compare their results.

## CI notes

**CI did not certify this package.** At unchanged head `844ea8372f3e1605bed1368f0a0135a177d6aa2f`, [run 43289715434](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43289715434), [plan job 131432409153](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43289715434/job/131432409153), failed in `Onboarding helper tests`. I read the completed checks once and independently read the failed job log.

The log reports exactly one failing test among 760 tests, with 24 skipped: `test_research_current_status.CurrentCiNavigationTests.test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`. At line 58, its AssertionError says that `` `make frontier7000-verify` `` was not found in the CI verification document. The `replay` job was skipped because `plan` failed; no hosted package replay ran.

I inspected the base files at canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`: `certificates/selected-result.json` names `make frontier7000-verify`, while `docs/ci-verification.md` still describes #6030 and `make frontier6030-verify`. The selected record, CI guide and failing test are unchanged by this PR. This is a repository-level mismatch, separate from this package's passing local verification.

I also independently read the failed-job logs for [run 42905094314](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42905094314), [run 42903313790](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42903313790), and [run 43280441536](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/43280441536). Each has the same sole failing test, the same missing-command assertion, and the same 760-test total with 24 skipped. No fix, retrigger commit, push or workflow rerun was made; maintainers own the repair of main.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated research package. The selected frontier, shared code and pinned evidence are unchanged.
